_about: Training Camp: its base's fence closed to walkers by a wall behind it, gateways included; a truck (pack training-camp-truck) in each of the 3 gateways; the meadow and the crater round the base are scenery. 26 FFA points use 500 integer milliseconds (requires the optional-ms client hook); legacy seconds are zero. The original TDM points and their protection are unchanged. Generated by scripts/stalker-maps/make_training_arena.py from training-fence.tsv and training-trucks.tsv.
